desc: The Ridgeline Safari is where timeless safari tradition meets Christensen precision engineering. At its heart is a beautifully crafted walnut stock—rich, balanced, and built to handle serious recoil. It brings warmth and heritage to a platform known for performance, giving hunters a rifle that looks as powerful as it shoots. Beneath the walnut lives pure capability. A precision-machined action cycles smoothly and reliably when the pressure is on. The free-floating, hand-lapped Aerograde carbon fiber barrel delivers strength without unnecessary weight, chambered in commanding calibers like .375 H&H, .300 Win Mag, 7mm Backcountry, and 7mm PRC. A radial muzzle brake helps manage magnum recoil, keeping you composed and on target for critical follow-up shots.
